# tool

> Markers and escapes inside the container.

- Run a command containing the closing marker text:

`tool ::: {{path}} \{\{literal\}\} {{多字节 → 参数}}`

- Unbalanced placeholder braces:

`tool {{unclosed`
<!-- mant:tldr:end -->

# A second container is ordinary document content

After the first container closes, this text has no special meaning.

## TLDR

An ordinary heading named TLDR is also plain content.
